calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as web_orders_black_friday
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = '2025-11-28'

SELECT 
  MIN(DATE(order_ts_utc)) as earliest_order,
  MAX(DATE(order_ts_utc)) as latest_order
FROM fact_web_order

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_orders,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN order_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_timestamps,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(order_ts_utc) = '2025-11-28' THEN 1 END) as black_friday_orders
FROM fact_web_order

SELECT 
  CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) AS order_date,
  COUNT(*) AS web_order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN order_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_timestamps,
  MIN(order_ts_utc) AS earliest_order,
  MAX(order_ts_utc) AS latest_order
FROM fact_web_order

SELECT 
  CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) AS order_date,
  COUNT(*) AS web_order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) >= '2025-11-26' 
  AND CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) <= '2025-11-30'
GROUP BY CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)
ORDER BY order_date

SELECT 
  status,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY status
